title: Shush
description: Adds a block to shush nearby sounds
body:
Shush adds three blocks to the game that can be used to muffle nearby sounds:

-   **Shush Block** - Muffles nearby sounds by 10% each.
-   **Filtered Shush Block** - Can be right-clicked to switch the sound type muffled. Muffles nearby sounds by 10% each.
-   **Advanced Shush Block** - Can be configured to muffle individual sounds by a given percentage
